ablations.PolicyFixedV3: Same signals, full exit at 3R, no partial/BE/trail
ablations.PolicyManagedV3: Preselected candidate: 1/3 quantity at 1.5R, remainder 3R; cost breakeven after actual partial; confirmed swing / 2ATR monotone trail
ablations.PolicyObjectiveV3: Fixed full exit; nearest qualified confirmed structure/prior-session objective between 2R and 3R that satisfies unchanged net RR; proxy profile stays shadow
ablations.PolicyRetraceV3: Fixed full exit; 0.15ATR retracement; original stop and target unchanged to isolate entry effect

protocol.classification: CURRENT_SURVIVORS; AUGUST-OCTOBER ALREADY INSPECTED IN PARENT WORK; NOVEMBER1 NEW POLICY EVALUATION, NOT A FULL INDEPENDENT HOLDOUT

continuation.pullback: prior 4 bars touch EMA20 or VWAP within 0.35ATR; deepest prior 6-bar extreme within 2.5ATR of reference
continuation.stop: prior 6-bar and signal extreme plus 0.2ATR; never tighten to manufacture leverage
continuation.trigger: closed break of previous high/low, trend-colored body, close in outer 35% of bar, rvol>=1
continuation.vwap_acceptance: at least 2 of prior 3 closes on trend side; valid UTC session, >=8 bars

protocol.data: Native Freqtrade public Gate downloads; preserve raw local only and compare old hashes; attempt bounded 1m detail; no interpolation, synthetic market prices, historical flow, news or membership reconstruction
protocol.execution: native engine only; limit candle-range fills are modeled; queue priority UNKNOWN; finer data does not establish real fills
protocol.hypothesis: A completed-hour trend with controlled multi-bar pullback and renewed participation offers more executable continuation economics than a thin signal-bar VWAP cross. Failed-boundary reversals require local rejection and contextual level significance or a genuine change of character. Logical pullback invalidation and bounded 3R objectives retain the same after-cost gate. Native partial harvesting plus delayed fee-aware stop tightening is an ablation, not an assumed economic improvement.

management.breakeven_cost: native fees + 0.002 friction + adverse funding 0.0003; funding paid increases reserve; never widen
management.thesis: two newly closed bars lose VWAP and EMA20 for continuation; reversal close reaccepts beyond reclaimed boundary

protocol.promotion: Functional/restart qualification separate from economic qualification. No persistent operation authorized by tests or positive development results.
protocol.ranking: causal signed 4h return relative BTC + capped participation, continuation in its hourly direction; reversal ranked by actual reclaim/ATR; top3 per recipe/side in fixed five-market survivor cohort, no future performance selection
protocol.reserved_holdout: 20261117-20261201 UNTOUCHED; no acquisition or outcome inspection

reversal.danger: opposing hourly EMA trend ADX>=25 requires local CHOCH; no universal hourly structure veto
reversal.failure: parent raw failed prior20 boundary + rvol>=1.2 and ADX<=30; no parent geometry prefilter
reversal.qualification: boundary within 0.5ATR of prior day/session/confirmed pivot OR local CHOCH in side direction
reversal.target: 3R bounded by 6ATR and unchanged net RR

risk.account_state: persisted UTC baseline/peak; missing/stale marks inhibit entries and cancel pending entries, exits continue
risk.missing_tiers: 1x permitted only if full collateral covers notional plus costs; >1x rejected
